title: Empirical 70-Cycle Architecture Deepening and Monolith Decomposition Corpus

isnad_claims.assertion: Monolithic Python files (> 200 LOC) can be partitioned into modular subpackages <= 200 LOC with zero functional regression using contract testing.
isnad_claims.evidence: Decomposed 70 monolithic hotspots into 100% passing subpackages with 1,008 cumulative regression tests passing in 94.28s.
isnad_claims.verified_by: pytest, ruff check, harness context govern

isnad_claims.assertion: Click CLI command groups must register all subcommands in a single co-located block to prevent later definitions from shadowing subcommands (Rule 6).
Single-seam resolver factories resolve_*(ctx) guarantee IoC micro-kernel compliance while providing deterministic in-process fallback (Rule 58).
isnad_claims.evidence: Implemented across codebase_context, context_type_system, youtube_transcript_fetcher, and skill_graph.
